about: Synthetic test requests for Suara, voiced by a TTS model with accent instructions. They exercise the flows; they do not replace recordings of real older speakers, which the PRD's per-language metric requires. Scripts written by Claude; audio generated by scripts/test-audio/generate.mjs.

phrases.text: Eh, just now got one man call me, say he is police, want my bank account number. Can give or not?
phrases.direction: Say this slowly, like a worried 75-year-old Singaporean man speaking Singlish, with small pauses

phrases.text: My doctor give me one letter, ask me go emergency. Got cheaper or not ah?
phrases.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman speaking Singlish, unhurried and a little unsure

phrases.text: I want to check my CPF. How to do ah?
phrases.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean man, speaking slowly

phrases.text: Hello? Hello? Can hear me or not?
phrases.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman testing a phone, slightly loud

phrases.text: I don't want machine. I want to talk to a real person.
phrases.direction: Say this like an impatient elderly Singaporean man

phrases.text: How to renew my passport ah? It expire already.
phrases.direction: Say this like an elderly Singaporean woman, calmly

phrases.text: My card ah, the one for money, the government one.
phrases.direction: Say this like a confused elderly Singaporean man, trailing off between phrases

phrases.text: Doctor ask me go A and E. Is it cheaper if the clinic send me?
phrases.direction: Say this in English with the accent of an elderly Malay Singaporean woman, slowly

phrases.text: The polyclinic doctor gave me a letter for emergency. Will it cost less?
phrases.direction: Say this in English with the accent of an elderly Tamil Singaporean man, slowly

phrases.text: 医生给我一张转介信，叫我去急诊。这样会不会比较便宜？
phrases.direction: 用新加坡年长妇女的口音，慢慢地、有点不确定地说
